Nadia: console alerted a small gap in billing-agg for EU around 03:10-03:25 UTC. looks like late arrivals after an ingest flake. thinking a tight, low-risk replay.
Sam: agree. prefer: canary dry-run -> console diff -> gated non-dry-run. keep tenant scope small (top 20).
Theo: raw counts: ~4,200 observed vs ~4,900 expected. ~14% short. query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM events_raw WHERE region='eu' AND ingested_at >= '2026-03-24 03:10' AND ingested_at < '2026-03-25 03:25';`
Marta: use `--ordering-guard` and `--idempotency-check` flags. also add `--kv-warmup=150` to avoid thundering cache misses.
Nadia: operator plan posted: 1) pick sample20 tenants 2) run dry-run with emit-diff + ordering guard 3) compare console diff 4) if ok, run 25% non-dry-run with token `ops-temp-7`. need oncall ack for non-dry-run.
ops-bot: oncall: theo@example.com until 2026-03-24T12:00Z. mention for approval.
Theo: oncall here, approve dry-run. ping me for non-dry-run.
Sam: creating canary dry-run: `./replay-cli run --start 2026-03-24T03:10Z --end 2026-03-24T03:25Z --tenant-list=sample20 --dry-run --emit-diff --ordering-guard --kv-warmup=150 --tags=canary-eu-03-10`
ops-bot: job created id=job_20260324_canary_eu, status=scheduled, owner=Sam. console: https://console/internal/replays/job_20260324_canary_eu
Sam: dry-run complete. console diff shows +4,180 events; matches raw sample. no duplicates flagged.
Marta: run idempotency-check script on job -> 0 dupes. good. recommend proceed to 25% non-dry-run with `--rate-limit=40rps` and token ops-temp-7.
Theo: approve 25% non-dry-run with rate-limit and token. I'll watch agg-service p95 and error-rate.
Nadia: launching stage1 non-dry-run -> job id=job_20260324_stage1. token=ops-temp-7, rate-limit=40rps. ops-bot: queued.
Sam: stage1 30% done after first 10m, KV miss stable, no error spikes.
Marta: small outlier: tenant gamma-llc shows a -0.4% difference on secondary metric due to merge logic; filing `ENG-telemetry-merge` ticket.
Theo: OK to proceed to full window at night with `--rate-limit=20rps`. request console feature: "reserve ephemeral token" so operators can claim without manual ConsoleOps handoff. filing UX tiny ticket.
Nadia: noted. thanks all. will post short postmortem if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
